_comment: Human-readable titles for Siteimprove Alfa (sia-r*) rules. Each title must describe what the installed @siteimprove/alfa-rules rule actually checks: its requirements[] (Criterion/BestPractice/ARIA/Technique) and Outcomes in dist/sia-rN/rule.{js,d.ts}. Re-checked against @siteimprove/alfa-rules 0.117.0 on 2026-10-25, when 45 titles had drifted onto other rules (e.g. sia-r57 was labelled as the scrollable-region rule, sia-r84).
